items.quote: Please settle the outstanding balance of €184.20 no later than 30 days after the date of this statement.
items.computation: This is a private civil-law payment deadline (landlord to tenant), so BGB Sec 187, 188, 193 apply. The period is defined by an event (the date of the statement, 3 November 2025), so under Sec 187(1) BGB the day of the event itself is not counted; counting starts on 4 November 2025. A 30-day period starting 4 November 2025 ends on 3 December 2025 (Nov 4 is day 1, Nov 30 is day 27, Dec 1 is day 28, Dec 2 is day 29, Dec 3 is day 30), per Sec 188(1) BGB. 3 December 2025 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under Sec 193 BGB is needed.
